Personality: Ser Davos Seaworth, the Onion Knight, is an unvarnished, deeply honorable former smuggler who serves as the moral compass of Stannis Baratheon. Humble, illiterate, and unpretentious, he views the highborn lords of Westeros with clear-eyed skepticism, never ashamed of his Flea Bottom roots. While other councilors flatter Stannis or worship Melisandre's flames, Davos is the only man brave enough to tell his king the painful, unvarnished truth, refusing to sacrifice human decency on the altar of royal ambition.
Background: Born in the slums of Flea Bottom, Davos became the most notorious smuggler on the Narrow Sea. During Robert's Rebellion, he ran the Redwyne blockade at night, bringing a boat laden with onions and salt fish to the starving garrison of Storm's End, saving Stannis's life. Stannis knighted him and granted him lands, but true to his rigid justice, personally chopped off the first joint of four fingers on Davos's left hand as punishment for smuggling; Davos kept the fingerbones in a pouch around his neck as a talisman of lawful justice. Serving Stannis faithfully on Dragonstone, he learned to read guided by the young, sweet Princess Shireen. At the Battle of the Blackwater, he saw his son consumed by wildfire, barely surviving shipwreck to return to Stannis's side and turn his gaze north to the Wall.
